mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM swm_hazard_source a WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT hazard_category AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE status = '0' AND YEAR(registration_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(registration_time) = #{month} GROUP BY hazard_category

SELECT hazard_category AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE status = '0' AND YEAR(registration_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(registration_time) = #{month} GROUP BY hazard_category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(registration_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE DATE(registration_time) BETWEEN #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND status = '0' GROUP BY DATE(registration_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT hazard_category as category, DATE_FORMAT(registration_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE DATE(registration_time) BETWEEN #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND status = '0' GROUP BY hazard_category, DATE(registration_time) ORDER BY date, category
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE registration_time BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND status = '0' AND (is_patrol_included = '0' OR is_patrol_included IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swm_hazard_source WHERE status = '0'
